state.guidance:
Each entry describes an airport. Assess whether the selected field is plausible
and consistent with the airport's name, municipality, and other location fields.
`iso_country` is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Coordinates are decimal
degrees. Latitude is positive north of the equator; longitude is positive east
of Greenwich. Elevation is in feet above sea level and may legitimately be
negative. Do not flag a field merely because it is uncommon. Assess each entry
independently using the supplied record and general geographic knowledge.
